ambiguityCues.note: “Full time” could mean full-time student status or full-time employment. Confirm with the caller; the tool does not assume either.
“Retired” applies to both federal civilian annuitants and retired uniformed service members, and their rules differ. Confirm which.
“Veteran” can mean a retired uniformed service member, a separated service member, or a federal civilian who served. Confirm the caller's current affiliation.
